integrity: Every infinite claim follows from exact Laurent-polynomial digit factorization and a sixteen-character Fourier calculation. Finite exact-arithmetic checks are supplementary, not a substitute for proof. Classical Lucas inputs and earlier modular results are credited.
limitations: Classification is for the prime five, two fixed combinatorial sequences, and complete blocks of index length five to an integer power; independent priority and scientific validation are pending.
title: Exact mod-five joint fibers and sharp quadratic correlation of central trinomial and Delannoy numbers
